title: CPA-MC 1.25.6 · read-oriented adaptation
hermes_traffic_scope: API-key usage entries only, not distinct accounts. OAuth and auth-file activity is excluded. No quota or credential health is inferred.
hermes_traffic_unavailable: API-key usage is unavailable, not zero.
hermes_traffic_no_entries: No observed API-key credentials. This does not mean zero global traffic; OAuth and auth-file activity is excluded.
hermes_traffic_window_unavailable: Recent API-key window unavailable, not zero. Lifetime counters remain available.
hermes_traffic_quiet: No requests in this valid API-key window. OAuth and auth-file activity is excluded.
hermes_traffic_active: Requests observed in this API-key window.
hermes_traffic_window_note: 20 ten-minute intervals, oldest to newest, including the current incomplete interval. Labels are relative bucket offsets, not server timestamps.
hermes_traffic_fleet_note: Usage entries and lifetime request totals and success rates by provider. Sparklines show the recent window. OAuth and auth-file activity is excluded.
unavailable: Unavailable — not zero. Check management readiness and the pinned CPA version.
providers_note: Persisted API-key group configuration, not live credential health. Names, URLs and keys are withheld. Unknown provider families are omitted. Missing priority means unknown, not zero.
auth_note: Auth-file and OAuth status unsupported: CPA 8.0.21 credential listing invokes quota/auth plugin callbacks and may read credential files. There is no guaranteed passive status contract. No login, callback, token refresh or credential acquisition is performed.
models_note: Codex static catalog only, not account availability or inference discovery. Identifiers must match the pinned finite catalog; unknown identifiers are withheld. Aliases are unsupported because arbitrary configured names can contain secrets. No inference calls.
quota_note: Quota observations unsupported: even credential listing can invoke plugin Describe/Identifier callbacks. Remote quota GET/refresh can call providers. No safe passive snapshot contract is available; no percentages are inferred and no provider calls are made.
logs_note: Latest 100 log lines projected to severity only. Unrecognized prefixes are unknown. Messages, paths, request IDs, cursors and downloads are withheld because they can contain secrets. File logging must already be enabled.
plugins_note: Plugin inventory unsupported: registered-plugin enumeration can invoke plugin identifier callbacks. Custom extension execution and installation are disabled.
disabled: Disabled: credential/auth-file/OAuth writes, alias edits, quota refresh and log clearing. CPA lacks atomic revision preconditions for these writes; partial failure can leave changed state. Native consent does not make them atomic. Full CPAMC parity is deferred.
